text: The Dragon General Fu Yuanshan will surely restore the Great Bastion, sever the reach of Chaos, and reshape peace within Cathay.

Qing Bao Tian Zun has succeeded in sparking a series of upheavals across Cathay. Miao Ying and Zhao Ming, suspicious of one another, have gone to war believing the other corrupted by Chaos. The rebel prince of Nan Yang besieges Wei Jing, seeking to remove the last obstacle in his path—the army Fu Yuanshan left behind to guard Po Mei. Meanwhile, Valkia has broken through the Great Bastion and comes knocking at its gates, while Fu Yuanshan, alone with his army, is blocked from returning by the forces of Chaos.\\nNow, Fu Yuanshan must break through the many obstacles set by Chaos, restore the Great Bastion, defend the land and its people, and bring peace back to the Cathayan Empire.
